reuse.why: No uniqueness check exists in the tree; one new guard using the existing db.first pattern is called by all five provider link functions.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; each copied link function adds only a short call with its own provider literal, as the tree's per-provider copies require.

placement.why: The guard sits beside the link handlers in accounts/app.ts and runs first in each, before any bank, account, payee or sync side effect; link.ts would be an equally reasonable home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: A clearly named single guard owns the rule; the provider string is repeated at each call and in each function's own insert/update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link paths call assertBankAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
